scenarios.description: The taxi's and parked cars' paint under a high summer sun, buildings close on both sides
scenarios.why: City-centre street, inner-city district (find: 12 lamps, 13 buildings, 4 colours within 70 x 40 m): a narrow street of 5-7 storey blocks whose walls the paint can reflect; June noon sun ~53 deg.

scenarios.description: Car paint highlights under street lamps and lit windows at night
scenarios.why: The same city-centre street pose: 12 street lamps within 70 x 40 m and apartment windows on both sides; October 22:30, sun far below the horizon.

scenarios.description: Wet asphalt and puddles in rain at night, lit by street lamps and the taxi's headlights
scenarios.why: city-centre street is paved city street with 12 lamps nearby; rain makes it fully wet; October 22:30.

scenarios.description: Facades of several building types and colours in daylight
scenarios.why: Second inner-city street (find: 14 buildings, 4 colours, 3 commercial within 70 x 40 m). OSM gives no facade materials here: colours and categories differ, materials cannot be promised.

scenarios.description: Window glass of commercial blocks reflecting the sky, overcast-free afternoon
scenarios.why: second inner-city street has the most commercial buildings found (3) beside apartment blocks: storefront and office glazing. No mapped glass or metal facades exist in the data; this tests the window glass.

scenarios.description: A generated roadwork on a way merged by map extension, outside the start box, top-down
scenarios.why: Oulu: the start --bbox is the motorway_through_traffic 0.6 km box (start_box_center); the cold-start tile window merges the tiles around it through map sync, which adds roadworks there. The pose is the midpoint of one of them from a run's server.log (a full-road work about 1 km west of the box). Readiness needs a roadworks entry in the view outside the start box. Daylight.

scenarios.description: Street lamps through dusk, night and dawn, then driving down the street
scenarios.why: Lamp-lined city street (find: 11 street lamps within 70 x 40 m, a straight street heading south): many lamps in view; October dusk 17:30, night 22:00, dawn 07:45. Each run drives 8 s and counts lamp light reassignments.

scenarios.description: Fixed dense-city view at night for repeatable rendering measurements
scenarios.why: City-centre street, inner-city district: dense blocks, 12 lamps and 13 buildings around; night so every light pool is active; the default zoom shows the most of it.

scenarios.description: The graphics settings' brightness 1.4 over a daylight street (compare with building_materials_day)
scenarios.why: The building_materials_day view (second inner-city street: facades, park, road) with the picture settings raised: the world brighter, the HUD unchanged.

scenarios.description: A road ferry at a ferry landing, the taxi waiting on the slip
scenarios.why: A road ferry (OSM route=ferry, ferry=secondary, 925 m): the taxi 8 m back from the route's east end, facing the deck of the ferry docked there (or under way, after its 40 s wait).

scenarios.description: The same ferry landing in the 2D view: the ferry drawn under the vehicles
scenarios.why: As ferry_car_3d, 2D: the ferry layer is below the cars it carries.

scenarios.description: Train model view at a city station
scenarios.why: The station tracks are real map data; the larger area includes the central station so timetable routes can be resolved.

scenarios.description: Fast traffic on a motorway through a mid-size city at 58 m/s: cars ahead of the taxi, passed and gone behind
scenarios.why: Motorway through a mid-size city (Oulu): a 1.76 km straight motorway from the start pose (find, 10 km Oulu world): fast traffic should be on it ahead of the taxi and not parked on it; daylight so the motorway is visible.

scenarios.description: Windshield view on a motorway through a mid-size city, driving at full throttle: traffic ahead and oncoming passes from ~70 m to ~5 m; a frame every 0.5 s
scenarios.why: Motorway through a mid-size city (Oulu): the motorway_through_traffic pose, which has fast traffic ahead of the taxi and on the other carriageway (seed 1). Every car crosses the old 22 m model swap and the 60 m radius; daylight so the cars are visible.

scenarios.description: A camper van, a caravan and a tent on their pitches at Nallikari camping, 2D top-down: the camper drawn at its streamed length
scenarios.why: Oulu, Nallikari camping: mapped point pitches inside the campsite; populate_camp_pitches puts a camper_van on the pitch at 425660.5, 7212600.6, a caravan 8 m west of it and a tent 16 m west (each pitch: campsites.py's 5 m envelope around the point). camera_at holds the camera between the camper and caravan pitches; the taxi waits on the campsite service road about 20 m north (pose), since on a pitch it would cover the camper and stand off the road. Zoom 5 (45 px/m) resolves the 0.24 m lights. Readiness needs the camper in view, its drawn body within 10 % of its row and each row's footprint inside its pitch. Daylight, clear.
